manifest.purpose: Hardened reference implementation. Provides `extern "C" int validate_dma(uint32_t base, uint32_t length, uint32_t region_start, uint32_t region_size)` in <cstdint>-only C++17, no main(). Logic: reject length==0 (return 0). Compute end = (uint64_t)base + (uint64_t)length and region_end = (uint64_t)region_start + (uint64_t)region_size, both widened to uint64_t so no 32-bit wraparound occurs. Return 1 iff (uint64_t)base >= (uint64_t)region_start AND end <= region_end, else 0. No pointer dereference of any parameter, no loops, O(1) fixed arithmetic, no I/O/exceptions/global state. Satisfies FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR4 by construction since all comparisons use exact unbounded-equivalent 64-bit arithmetic that cannot wrap for any 32-bit inputs (max possible sum is 2*UINT32_MAX, well within uint64_t range).
